# SCI-JINC-ODQ-104 — Scientific-Owner Disposition

Status: owner approved; bounded Stage A disposition

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-08-28`

## Approved Scientific Disposition

SCI-JINC v0.1 authorizes `jinc_coefficient_squared_time` as its sole base-v0.1
time-support product:

```text
T_p^(kappa^2) = sum_i I_ip kappa_ip^2/f_s,i.
```

The squared object is the signed dimensionless JINC coefficient `kappa_ip`.
The product carries seconds and is method-specific coefficient-squared
temporal accounting. It is not physical acquired exposure, valid-original
exposure, complete temporal support, hits, normalized influence, white-noise-
equivalent time, precision, validity, confidence, or significance.

A separate physical-exposure product is deferred until an identified
scientific use requires it. That future scientific use must authorize a
distinct product with exact original-occurrence exposure lineage, membership,
units, ownership, semantics, availability, provenance, and consumer meaning.
It must not reinterpret `jinc_coefficient_squared_time` as physical exposure
or distribute one physical integration through every JINC lobe.

## Stage Consequence

`SCI-JINC-ODQ-104` is closed for base-v0.1 time-support product scope. The
decision changes sanitized Stage A author-control bytes and remains subject to
renewed exact-byte approval under `SCI-JINC-STAGE-A-Q002`. It does not launch
Stage B, create a physical-exposure product, modify implementation, or
establish conformity, validation, achieved performance, readiness, or
production status.
